description: READ-ONLY (builds no tx). Quotes an exact-in single-hop `tokenIn` → `tokenOut` swap (the same shape build_swap executes) via QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle — the live amountOut the pool would give at its CURRENT price, without sending a tx. Returns amountOut (wei), amountOutMin (amountOut after slippageBps, default 0.5% — feed this straight into build_swap), sqrtPriceX96After, initializedTicksCrossed, and gasEstimate. Call this immediately before build_swap: a quote read even a block earlier can go stale enough that the amountOutMin it produced reverts the swap.
name: get_swap_quote
title: Quote a token→token swap (Uniswap v3 QuoterV2)
